subject: Service availability impact — remediation credits & trial extension request
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmeretail.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intermittent generate failures this morning (prod)

Hi Mina —

We experienced a spike of 5–10s tail latency and several 503 errors across our US-West requests between 06:05–07:20 PDT this morning. This impacted our checkout recommendation service — roughly ~18% of requests failed and the rest saw degraded latency. Our engineering and ops teams had to roll a quick fallback to cached recommendations which affected personalization.

Can Redwood confirm the root cause and advise on remediation? We will need a formal incident summary and would like to discuss a compensation path (credits + an extension of our evaluation trial) — this was a business-impacting window for us.

I can provide logs if helpful; attaching a small summary from our side.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
VP Platform Engineering, Acme Retail
S: +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: acme_error_samples.txt (referenced)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmeretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent generate failures this morning (prod)

Hi Sanjay —

Really sorry to hear this — thank you for sending the samples. I’ve escalated to Ops and the incident response team (looping Marissa + Jonas). We’ll prioritize a root-cause analysis and get you an initial update within 24 hours.

Quick asks so we can scope remediation and compensation:
- Can you share the production dataset ID or the approximate token volume affected during the window (a rough number is fine)?
- Any customer-facing consequences we should be aware of beyond what you described?

We take incidents like this seriously — our goal is to restore confidence quickly. I’ll follow up with the proposed goodwill package (credits + trial extension) after Ops confirms the RCA.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2028 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Intermittent generate failures this morning (prod) — proposed remedial package

Team —

Ops postmortem (attached) shows a transient autoscaler race + degraded KV-cache eviction behavior that increased tail latency for requests with long context windows. Impact window: 06:03–07:28 PDT. Affected token-exchange estimated at ~1.2M tokens for Acme during that timeframe (see usage_snapshot_20280620.csv).

Proposed remediation package to offer Acme (recommended):
1) One-time credit: $25,000 applied against June billing (equivalent to ~250k generation units at their pricing tier).
2) Trial/POC extension: add 30 days of trial evaluation access for any of their product teams (extend existing trial subscription to 2028-07-31).
3) Operational gesture: a 1:1 postmortem session with our infra leads + priority triage window for 30 days.

Notes: legal/finance flagged that we should avoid language implying SLA payout; position this as a "goodwill credit". Jonas — please confirm availability for the postmortem call. Karthik — any objections on the $25k number or does finance want to round?

Marissa
Director, Customer Reliability
Attachment: incident_root_cause.pdf
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmeretail.com>, Acme Retail Billing <billing@acmeretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Offer: goodwill credit and trial extension following service impact (Acme)

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for your patience while we investigated. Attached is our postmortem and a usage snapshot that informed our remediation proposal. We own the disruption and would like to make this right with a goodwill package:

Summary of the offer:
- One-time goodwill credit: $25,000 (to be applied to your June invoice).
- Trial extension: additional 30 days of evaluation access for any Acme product team (new trial expiry 2028-07-31).
- Ops session: 60-minute postmortem call with our infra/engineering leads (we can schedule next week at your convenience).

How this will be applied:
- Credit will be applied via your account billing record (please confirm billing@acmeretail.com as the contact).
- You’ll receive a short PDF with the credit reference number and steps to apply the credit to your ledger (attached: credit_apply_instructions.pdf).

We’re not positioning this as an SLA penalty; it's a gesture to acknowledge the impact and restore confidence. If this package looks reasonable, please reply with any preferred times for the postmortem call and confirmation of the billing contact. We’ll action the credit within 3 business days of your confirmation.

Sanjay — happy to hop on a quick call if you want to run through details.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 650-555-0124

Attachments: incident_root_cause.pdf, usage_snapshot_20280620.csv, credit_apply_instructions.pdf
